Finite coefficient algebras model diagonal algebras after scalar extension; no nontrivial inseparable extension of a finite field is asserted.

Odd-characteristic square-zero examples are algebra controls, not claimed diagonals of inseparable degree-four field extensions.
No assertion about general homotopy-colimit depth, positive gluing formulas, arbitrary diagonal pieces or parent solution.
